business_problem: Precina needed to scale high-touch diabetes care beyond a small pilot, but fragmented medical and payer data slowed telehealth visits, delayed onboarding, and made personalized outreach difficult across underserved communities.
solution_summary: Precina is combining Agentforce, Health Cloud, and Data Cloud to turn diabetes care from sporadic appointments into a continuous digital-support model that can scale nationally. Instead of asking providers to manually retrieve lab results, EMR data, images, prescriptions, and payer information from disconnected systems, the Salesforce data layer is designed to surface a current patient picture that Agentforce can use during support interactions. Agentforce will review medical context, recommend incremental lifestyle changes, support refill coordination, trigger alerts for paraprofessionals, and personalize outreach messages, while the same agent layer helps automate payer contracting and patient qualification workflows that previously slowed expansion. Health Cloud and digital onboarding workflows let the company keep clinical, administrative, and recruitment tasks on one trusted platform so staff can focus on patient care while AI handles repetitive yet time-sensitive steps.
data_flow: Lab results, EMR data, imaging, prescriptions, and payer information are brought into a connected Salesforce patient record, which Agentforce uses to recommend interventions, trigger outreach, confirm eligibility, and hand context-rich tasks to providers or paraprofessionals.
business_outcome: Precina expects cheaper administrative scaling, faster patient onboarding, more continuous care interactions, and better clinical outcomes by using AI to automate support and payer workflows around a unified patient record.
metrics: A1C levels from 9.6% to 6.4% in just 12 weeks
Estimated $80,000 per year for every 5,000 patients
architecture_clues: Agentforce uses connected patient data to recommend support actions and automate payer outreach.
Health Cloud supports digital onboarding in place of manual or in-person processes.
The deployment is explicitly designed to stay compliant with HIPAA standards.
